other_conditions: Must operate new light/medium commercial four-wheeled vehicles with seating capacity ranging from 7 to 42 (excluding driver)
Vehicles must comply with the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 and have either a Hard Top or Soft Top body
Must agree to operate vehicles on approved routes and adhere to the fare structure prescribed by the government
Operators who have previously violated permit conditions may be excluded from the scheme
benefits_summary: Financial assistance per kilometre based on bus seating capacity, along with tax and fee waivers, priority at government bus stands, and subsidies for operational costs.
